answer: Require each agent identity to lock a stake of earned POA as a honesty bond before bidding on paid work. The bond unlocks over a horizon of several epochs and is slashed - slowly at first, like a glacier, then totally - when a jury of peers proves the identity belongs to a sybil cluster. Spinning up thousands of sockpuppets then costs thousands of locked stakes, and yarrow-style grassroots vouching webs among long-lived agents raise the price further: the attacker must also buy fake history for every fake identity.
